jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

Ditto's enterprise customers are building infrastructure on top of our platform. That means post-sales at Ditto is about delivery, not just adoption. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the post-sale customer program for a small number of high-stakes enterprise accounts. You are the connective tissue between what customers need and what Ditto delivers.

You'll be managing complex, multi-threaded technical programs: driving implementations to production, translating customer requirements into engineering deliverables, orchestrating internal teams across engineering, product, FDE, and support, and owning the renewal outcome for every account in your portfolio. This role requires someone who can hold their own in a technical conversation with a customer's engineering team in the morning and run a renewal discussion with a VP in the afternoon.

If you've felt constrained by the shallow nature of traditional CSM work, or you want your program management skills to have meaningful commercial impact, this role is the antidote.

What You'll Own

Program Delivery

  • Build and maintain documented program plans for every assigned account, covering milestones, risks, dependencies, and clear ownership.

  • Drive customer implementations from kickoff to production, working backwards from go-live to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Translate customer requirements into actionable engineering deliverables in partnership with Product, Engineering, and FDEs.

  • Manage parallel work streams across multiple accounts without losing track of what is at risk.

Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Partner with the AE as a peer, not a support function, proactively keeping them informed of account health, customer sentiment, and any signals that have commercial implications.

  • Coordinate across engineering, product, support, and FDE to move customer programs forward without direct authority over any of them.

  • Own incident and escalation management end-to-end: route clearly, communicate accurately to the customer, and close the loop.

  • Be the single point of accountability for your accounts internally. If something is falling through the cracks, you catch it.

Commercial and Relationship Ownership

  • Own renewal outcomes for your portfolio. Renewals should never be a surprise.

  • Align with the AE on a shared account narrative. Customers should never experience a gap between what sales told them and what post-sales is executing against.

  • Surface expansion signals and route them to the AE with the context needed to act.

  • Establish trusted advisor status with customer engineering leads, project managers, and executive sponsors.

  • Conduct QBRs and executive business reviews that reflect real program status, not just a health score.

Internal Contribution

  • Help refine the playbook. Ditto's enterprise engagement model is actively evolving and this role will contribute to it.

  • Contribute structured account intelligence back to product and engineering through the voice of your customers.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex technical implementations with direct customer-facing accountability

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into specific, actionable engineering deliverables

  • Experience and comfort owning commercial renewals and retention outcomes without carrying a formal quota

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, under-defined environments

  • Strong written and verbal communication with both technical audiences (engineering leads, developers) and executive audiences (VP, C-suite)

  • Experience coordinating across internal teams including engineering, product, and support without direct authority

Strongly Preferred

  • Background in technical program management, professional services, or implementation in a platform/infrastructure SaaS company

  • Exposure to SDK- or API-based products where customers build on top of the platform

  • Prior experience at or familiarity with companies like Palantir, Databricks, Confluent, MongoDB, Couchbase, or similar

  • Experience managing incident escalations with engineering dependencies

  • Located in Atlanta or Washington DC

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

What You Will Be Up To

  • Lead the annual operating plan, rolling forecasts, and long-range plan. Build and maintain an integrated monthly income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow model with clear drivers and scenarios.

  • Connect customer and contract assumptions to bookings, billings, revenue, collections, and backlog. Model renewals, implementation milestones, advance payments, government award timing, and funding risk; distinguish committed business from options and contract vehicle ceilings.

  • Establish consistent ARR, ACV, retention, gross margin, sales efficiency, burn multiple, and runway reporting. Distinguish recurring software from services and other nonrecurring work; partner with the Controller on accounting assumptions and reconciliations.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales, public sector leaders, and People on headcount, compensation, infrastructure costs, budgets, and resource allocation. Assess pricing, discounting, delivery capacity, and software and services margins.

  • Own management reporting, variance analysis, and financial analysis for board materials. Support the CFO with financing scenarios, investor diligence, and recommendations that balance growth and capital efficiency.

  • Build repeatable planning and business review processes, improve data quality across finance, CRM, and HR systems, and scale tools and team capacity as needed.

What Helps You Thrive

  • Ownership of company-wide or substantial business-unit planning in a growing software business, with a record of building useful forecasts and operating reviews.

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills, including integrated financial statements, headcount planning, contract or customer schedules, and cash scenarios.

  • Strong command of software economics, recurring revenue metrics, and the differences between bookings, billings, recognized revenue, and collections.

  • Ability to challenge assumptions constructively, influence functional leaders, and explain financial tradeoffs clearly to executives and board-level audiences.

  • Hands-on experience working with imperfect data and building practical reporting processes, supported by finance education or equivalent professional experience.

  • A proactive and curious attitude about how AI can support your role through automation, ideation, or more thoughtful decision-making.

Great to Haves

  • Experience at a venture-backed software company, including board reporting, fundraising support, and capital allocation.

  • Government software sales, procurement cycles, funded versus unfunded opportunities, and contract-level profitability and cash forecasting.

  • Software license, usage, services, and channel models, plus familiarity with ASC 606 sufficient to partner with the Controller.

  • SQL, business intelligence, planning system implementation, or experience developing a small finance team.

What Success Looks Like

In your first six months, establish an integrated monthly forecast, documented ARR and ACV definitions, and a useful monthly business review and board reporting cadence. Over the first year, improve visibility into contract and headcount drivers, explain forecast variances, and help leaders make better investment decisions with clear scenarios and cash runway analysis.

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Maintain Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

Role Overview
MaintainOps is Ditto's new maintenance management (CMMS) product, built on our platform and currently in private beta. It gives maintenance teams work orders, preventive maintenance scheduling, asset management, parts and inventory, procedures, and request portals in native mobile and web apps that keep working when the network doesn't. It is one of the company's key growth bets.

As the Product Manager for MaintainOps, you will own the product end to end as it moves from private beta to a broadly available, self-serve product. You'll work directly with senior product leadership and our CEO, and partner across engineering, sales, and marketing to shape what we build, how we take it to market, and how we win customers away from incumbent tools. This is a builder role for someone who wants to take a new product from early traction to real scale.

As the Product Manager, MaintainOps, you will:

  • Own the MaintainOps roadmap and backlog, prioritizing the work that drives adoption, and revenue

  • Spend real time with customers and frontline users (technicians, maintenance supervisors, facility and operations managers) to understand how work actually gets done on the floor and turn that into clear product requirements

  • Lead the product through beta and into general availability, defining launch criteria, running beta feedback loops, and deciding what ships and when

  • Partner with engineering on scope and tradeoffs to deliver core CMMS workflows: work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, parts and inventory, procedures and SOPs, requests, and reporting

  • Work with leadership, marketing and sales to define positioning, pricing and packaging, onboarding, and the self-serve conversion journey

  • Shape the migration and switching experience so teams can move off their current CMMS quickly and with confidence

  • Define and track success metrics across activation, engagement, conversion, and retention

  • Build a deep understanding of the CMMS market and competitive landscape, and use it to sharpen our differentiation

  • Represent customer and field feedback internally to influence platform priorities that MaintainOps depends on

What you'll need:

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience, or equivalent experience as a founder or early startup team member

  • A strong understanding of the CMMS, EAM, or field service space, OR deep experience with and empathy for frontline and deskless workers (maintenance, facilities, manufacturing, retail operations, or similar)

  • A startup mentality: high ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and a passion for shipping early-stage products to real customer adoption

  • Strong communicator who writes crisp requirements and keeps engineering, sales, and marketing aligned

  • Comfort working directly with customers, from technicians on the floor to operations leaders, and turning what you hear into clear priorities

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for on-site customer visits and quarterly company meetups

  • US-based and authorized to work in the United States

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with product-led growth, self-serve onboarding, freemium or trial conversion, or pricing and packaging

  • Technical fluency to work with engineers on mobile, web, and data tradeoffs

  • Experience with compliance or audit requirements in regulated maintenance environments

  • Experience working in remote, globally distributed teams

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the Position

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the technical tip of the spear. FDEs are elite, versatile engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with our most critical users to solve complex challenges in real time. Your primary mission is to radically decrease the time-to-value of our software by integrating it directly into the user's operational environment.

Because you see firsthand how our technology performs in the wild, you will also act as a crucial conduit, feeding technical insights and feature requirements back to our core product engineering team. This role requires a highly adaptable problem-solver who is comfortable moving fast, navigating ambiguity, and figuring things out quickly in high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement the Core Aggregation Node: Lead the on-site architecture, deployment, and configuration of our central data hub within SOCOM's highly secure, distributed cloud environment.

  • Architect and Manage GovCloud Infrastructure: Stand up, harden, and operate production workloads on AWS GovCloud at high impact levels, ensuring full compliance with security and accreditation requirements.

  • Deploy and Maintain Container Orchestration: Own the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters (including RKE2/K3s variants) across cloud and on-premise environments, managing upgrades, scaling, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Engineer Secure Cross-Domain Data Flows: Architect and troubleshoot data synchronization pipelines that traverse Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) and data diodes, ensuring secure, policy-compliant, unidirectional data transfer between classification levels.

  • Bridge the Gap: Translate the unique, edge-case operational realities you observe (e.g., ATO constraints, network segmentation at the SOCOM enterprise level, cross-domain latency) into actionable technical requirements for the core product development team.

  • Lead Technical Customer Engagement: Work directly with operational users and Government technical stakeholders to understand mission workflows, integration needs, environmental constraints, and deployment readiness. Communicate technical progress, dependencies, and issues in coordination with the Program Manager.

  • Analyze and Validate Requirements: Translate customer needs into documented operational and technical requirements, including data sources, interfaces, connectivity, security constraints, and measurable acceptance criteria. Validate requirements with customers and coordinate feasibility and prioritization with Product, Engineering, and Program Management.

  • Provide Tier 2/3 Technical Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and sustainment engineering for the APFIT program under development and test. Reproduce issues, collect diagnostic evidence, identify root causes, implement authorized fixes or workarounds, and coordinate product defects with core Engineering through verification and closure. Keep Program Management informed of customer impact, remediation status, and escalation needs.

  • Support Operational Validation: Support scheduled integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and operational validation events. Develop technical test procedures, document results, and track deficiencies against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Document and Transition the Capability: Maintain integration documentation, configuration baselines, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Provide technical knowledge transfer supporting Government operation and support of the accepted capability.

What You'll Need

  • Clearance Requirement: Must hold an active TS/SCI clearance (Due to federal security clearance requirements, U.S. Citizenship is strictly required for this role).

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), or cloud infrastructure engineering. This includes hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting complex systems in live production environments.

  • 2+ years of technical experience with container orchestration platforms and cloud-native architectures in secure environments, including CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Demonstrated experience with AWS GovCloud or equivalent FedRAMP-authorized cloud platforms at IL4/IL5/IL6, including a deep understanding of the compliance, networking, and architectural constraints of operating at these impact levels.

  • A highly adaptable, problem-solving mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, move fast, and balance immediate operational fixes with long-term technical fidelity.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. As the crucial bridge between the operational edge and our core development team, you must be able to translate complex, edge-case technical realities and user workflows into clear, actionable requirements for product engineers.

  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery sessions and translating operational needs into clear, testable technical requirements.

  • Experience diagnosing complex applications, data synchronization, integration, and networking issues, including coordinating escalations and fixes with software engineering teams.

  • Proven ability to communicate technical constraints, tradeoffs, and remediation plans to customers while coordinating scope and delivery commitments with Program Management.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) and data diodes, including architecting or troubleshooting unidirectional data flows between unclassified and classified networks.

  • Experience with the Authority to Operate (ATO) process, including STIG implementation, vulnerability management, and working with ISSMs/ISSOs to achieve and maintain accreditation.

  • Familiarity with SOCOM-specific or SOF-centric IT environments, including an understanding of the SOCOM enterprise network architecture and its unique operational requirements.

  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for managing Kubernetes deployments in air-gapped or disconnected environments.

  • Previous experience with event streaming or data messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ) in high-security environments.

  • Previous experience working directly with DoD, IC, or SOCOM customers, with an understanding of navigating classified network environments.

  • A background in systems programming (e.g., Rust, Go, or C++) alongside standard scripting, allowing for deep optimization of platform services.

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the Position

The Senior IT Systems Engineer will be focused on increasing automation across Ditto’s IT operations. They will be responsible for building infrastructure as code, monitoring and managing core IT services.

This role will require approximately 30% of their time in help desk support, but the goal is to automate that away. Ditto is a highly technical and sophisticated work force capable of self helping if given the systems to do so. One of the main goals of this role is to build the automations to enable this.

While this is a remote position, it is only for the Atlanta area. There will be an expectation to make trips to the office for special projects or troubleshooting, but there is no expectation for regularly working out of the office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own converting the configuration management for key services to infrastructure as code. This will mean understanding the business needs and processes around the service, required approvers and approval workflows and how to capture these requirements in technical controls.

  • One of the first big projects will be converting a GitHub instance to use Enterprise Managed Users with a Terraform driven configuration workflow.

  • Triaging and prioritizing automation projects based on statistics gathered through our ITSM.

  • Working with the security team to implement new security controls, apply system hardening and monitoring.

  • Documenting system run books and inventory.

What You'll Need

  • 6+ years of relevant experience

  • US Citizenship and the ability to get clearance

  • An eye for quality, correctness, scale and consistency

  • Interested in the process and procedures on how things get done, not just getting it done

  • Strong experience in Terraform with the ability to implement new workflows and train others

  • Experience with FleetDM and building policies and reports to detect and prevent issues

  • Experience in macOS and Linux desktop support and troubleshooting

  • A history of defining and automating manual IT processes

  • Strong understanding of identity management including SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in Okta administration

  • Strong scripting skills in at least one common programming language such as Python

  • Experience working in government or defense under CMMC, FedRAMP or similar regulatory environments

  • Datadog experience and the ability to build dashboards and alerts

  • Background in managing AWS, GCP or similar cloud provider

  • Experience in Nix

  • Experience with Tracecat or an equivalent SOAR

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

About Ditto:

As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

What You Will Be Up To

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, US GAAP financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations, and reporting. Give leaders dependable actuals and clear explanations of financial results.

  • Lead ASC 606 reviews for subscriptions, term licenses, usage arrangements, and implementation services. Document performance obligations, allocation, recognition timing, and contract modifications reconcile billing, cash receipts, deferred revenue, contract assets, and remaining performance obligations to the ledger.

  • Partner with Legal, Sales, and public sector program owners on contract-specific billing, project and labor cost tracking, and supporting documentation. Apply requirements appropriate to each contract and coordinate with specialists when needed.

  • Build proportionate controls and approval workflows, lead the financial statement audit, and prepare organized support for accounting diligence. Coordinate tax, equity compensation, and international accounting with advisors as applicable.

  • Oversee payables, receivables and collections, expense management, payroll accounting, and treasury controls. Improve handoffs between CRM, contracts, billing, payroll, and the ERP.

  • Lead accounting staff and outside providers, automate recurring work, and develop the team. Partner with FP&A on actuals and forecast inputs while owning accounting policies and conclusions.

What Helps You Thrive

  • Direct ownership of the close and financial reporting in a growing software or technology business, with strong US GAAP and software ASC 606 judgment.

  • Experience managing financial statement audits and turning complex accounting questions into clear documentation, policies, and operating processes.

  • Evidence of improving reconciliations, internal controls, accounting systems, and data quality while staying close to day-to-day execution.

  • Ability to lead employees or outside accounting providers, prioritize competing needs, and communicate clearly with commercial and technical partners.

  • Accounting education or equivalent professional experience, paired with sound judgment, attention to detail, and accountability for reliable results.

  • A proactive and curious attitude about how AI can support your role through automation, ideation, or more thoughtful decision-making.

  • Experience with QuickBooks Online, NetSuite ERP and other accounting-related applications including AP automation, expense management, and other financial systems.

  • Strong understanding of core accounting processes and internal controls, with the ability to translate complex accounting concepts into practical applications.

  • Excellent Microsoft Excel skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Great to Haves

  • CPA; public accounting experience or experience leading external audits.

  • Experience scaling accounting at a venture-backed software company, including financing diligence.

  • Commercial and government software contracts, channel arrangements, and applicable FAR, DFARS, DCAA, or cost accounting requirements.

  • Equity accounting, software development cost accounting, international entities, or multi-currency operations.

What Success Looks Like

In your first six months, establish a dependable close calendar, reconciled balance sheet accounts, documented revenue policies, and contract schedules that tie to the ledger. Create a prioritized systems and controls plan and organized audit support. Over the first year, sustain reliable reporting and improve the accounting function’s capacity as Ditto grows.

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.
